name: ast-core-infra
description: Alchemy IaC for ast-core (isolated deploy tooling; Effect 4 per Alchemy peers; service stays on Effect 3).

scripts.build: pnpm run build:web -- && pnpm run build:worker --
scripts.check: pnpm run build -- && pnpm run typecheck -- && pnpm run test -- && pnpm run verify:bundle --
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build -- && pnpm run verify:bundle -- && npx --no-install alchemy deploy --config alchemy.run.ts
scripts.plan: pnpm run build -- && pnpm run verify:bundle -- && npx --no-install alchemy deploy --dry-run --config alchemy.run.ts
